nodes.label: Mirror Market Design System (Industrial Dark)
nodes.rationale: Bloomberg Terminal meets modern developer tools, aimed at defense-tech hiring managers viewing the repo as a portfolio piece. GitHub dark palette chosen over pure black for dense-data readability; Geist typography to signal engineering craft over template dashboards; dark-only because trading desks use dark themes; minimal decoration so typography and color hierarchy do the visual work; fixed sidebar for persistent nav plus data freshness at a glance.
